units.source_text: 岛村这才知道驹子有这样一个男人。

en.t: Only then did Shimamura learn that Komako had such a man in her life.

units.source_text: 说是从她十七岁那年开始跟了他五年。

en.t: It was said that she had been with him for five years, starting when she was seventeen.

units.source_text: 岛村很早以前就觉得有点惊讶。

en.t: Shimamura had felt somewhat puzzled about it for a long time.

units.source_text: 后来才明白驹子何以那么无知和毫无警戒。

en.t: Only later did he understand why Komako was so ignorant and so completely unguarded.
